samples.text: Part 2. You will hear the chairman of Standthorpe Twinning Association, which organizes the link between Standthorpe in England and a town in France, talking to members about the year's events. First, you have some time to look at questions 11 to 15. It's great to see so many members of the Twinning Association here tonight. Since the Twinning Link between our two towns, Stan Thorpe, here in England, and Malat in France was established. The relationship between the towns has gone from strength to strength. Last month, 25 members of the association from Stanthorpe spent a weekend in Malat. Our hosts had arranged a great programme.
